Fuzzes the HTTP server with random HTTP and WebSocket client actions.

# Purpose
This file is a fuzz test harness for the `fd_http_server` code. It creates an HTTP server instance with fixed limits for HTTP and WebSocket connections, starts the server on a local loopback port, and then drives it with random client actions. The harness uses input bytes as a source of pseudo-random data to build HTTP requests, WebSocket frames, and random API calls into the server while a worker thread polls the server in parallel.

The main purpose is to exercise server state changes and error paths under many input patterns. It defines callbacks for HTTP requests and WebSocket events, opens and closes client sockets, sends normal HTTP traffic or WebSocket traffic, and sometimes mutates the generated data before sending it. The file also manages cleanup of sockets, server memory, and the polling thread after each fuzzing run.
